name: hipaa-security-privacy-compliance-suite
known_facts: HIPAA Security Rule has Administrative, Physical, and Technical Safeguards
Privacy Rule covers NPP, minimum necessary, patient rights, and administrative requirements
Breach Notification Rule requires 60-day notification for 500+ affected individuals
Risk analysis is the foundational HIPAA requirement
Business Associate Agreements required with all vendors handling ePHI
OCR enforces HIPAA with penalties up to $1.9M per violation category per year
Right of Access is the most common OCR enforcement action
Encryption is addressable but strongly preferred
HITECH Act expanded HIPAA to Business Associates directly
Ransomware is presumptively a breach under HIPAA

input.ephi_systems: Epic EHR, Practice Fusion PM, MyChart patient portal, Office 365 email, file shares
